optionalTools.name: Dedicated dependency maintenance App token action
optionalTools.scope: Only this repository: short-lived contents, pull-requests and workflows write token for tested dependency branches and PRs; no release publication or environment administration.
optionalTools.updatePolicy: SHA pin v3.2.0; tracked by the workflow input scan. Explicit separately provisioned App client ID and private key; built-in GITHUB_TOKEN remains read-only. Token revoked by the action at job completion.

optionalTools.name: Dedicated evidence guardian App token action
optionalTools.scope: Optional separately provisioned evidence repository only; token restricted to that repository, checks write and contents/pull requests read.
optionalTools.updatePolicy: SHA pin v3.2.0; tracked by the workflow input scan. No automatic provisioning or secret setup. Review upgrades with dependency maintenance.

optionalTools.name: GitHub CLI repair feedback
optionalTools.scope: Optional fresh read-only correlation/history/status and exact-content-approved issue, consumer-fork and evidence PR delivery to explicit Program Kit repositories.
optionalTools.updatePolicy: Use the installed device CLI; no automatic installation or login. Public delivery fails closed on lookup, security, provisioning or authentication failure. Local queuing remains independent.

optionalTools.name: GitHub CLI package candidate inspection
optionalTools.scope: Required exact-source successful CI run/job metadata and immutable artifact-digest verification; local read-only candidate inspection. Publication remains behind native GitHub environment approval.
optionalTools.updatePolicy: Use the runner/device GitHub CLI; fail closed on lookup, authentication, expired artifacts or digest mismatch. No automatic device installation or unrelated pin update.

optionalTools.name: GitHub CLI
optionalTools.scope: Optional authenticated read-only account verification and explicitly supplied story decision references.
optionalTools.updatePolicy: Use the device-supported GitHub CLI API command; no toolkit version pin or automatic installation. Missing/unavailable access leaves new identity/decisions pending.
